# Project Deep Dive and Paper Presentation

[← Scale AI](../README.md) · [Every Scale AI question](../../scale-ai.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/project-deep-dive-and-paper-presentation)

`domain-knowledge` `ml-knowledge`

---

## Expectations

- Select an earlier project or paper that fits the team you are targeting.
- Be prepared to discuss:
  - What the problem was and why it was important.
  - What you owned and the specific work you contributed.
  - What made the project difficult.
  - The architecture or model decisions.
  - Which alternatives you evaluated and why you rejected them.
  - The trade-offs and constraints.
  - What you would do differently if you repeated the work.
- MLE presentation version:
  - Choose an earlier paper to present.
  - Defend the selected model architecture.
  - Describe why you did not use a different architecture.
  - Aim for a presentation lasting roughly 30-45 minutes, based on the round format.
- HM screen version:
  - Go deeply into a project.
  - Explain why Scale AI interests you.
  - Discuss whether the project matches the team and its work direction.

## Observations

- The round may feel informal, but it remains technical. Broad project overviews are not strong; prepare details about decisions.
- Effective answers tie the business or research setting to the technical decision: why you selected that model, data pipeline, evaluation approach, or system boundary.
- For teams working with LLMs, select a project involving post-training, evaluation, RAG, agents, model serving, data quality, or integrating AI into a customer-facing product if you have one.

## Preparation

- Have two projects ready: one centered on ML/LLMs and another focused on systems/products, allowing you to adjust to the interviewer’s emphasis.
- Sketch the architecture or experiment process before the interview, then practice a 5-minute summary followed by a 25-minute deep dive.
- For each significant decision, record one alternative you declined and why it was not selected.
